shellCommands.command: ls -R app && cat package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json

node -e "const n=require('/workspace/node_modules/next/navigation.js'); console.log(Object.keys(n))" 2>/dev/null || node --input-type=module -e "import * as n from '/workspace/node_modules/next/navigation.js'; console.log(Object.keys(n))"

grep -rl "authInterrupts" node_modules/next/dist/server/config*.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -o "authInterrupts[^,}]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js 2>/dev/null | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25

(npm start &>/tmp/next.log & echo $! > /tmp/next.pid) && sleep 4 && curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin && grep -o "Access Forbidden\|403" /tmp/admin.html | sort -u; kill $(cat /tmp/next.pid)
